content.text: In Pakistan, creators face a major obstacle when it comes to selling digital downloads: Stripe, PayPal, and other major payment gateways are either unavailable or severely restricted. This means that the vast majority of digital products, from ebooks to course materials, cannot be sold online. In this post, we'll explore the infrastructure problems facing Pakistan's digital creators and highlight the solution: Edge Commerce Stack ($197) - a sovereign commerce infrastructure that lets creators sell digital products to international buyers without relying on Stripe or PayPal.
What Each Option Actually Offers

Let's look at the limitations of the current solutions. Stripe and PayPal are not available in Pakistan, making it difficult for creators to collect payments. Gumroad and Paddle, while available, charge high fees and lack the flexibility to handle international transactions. This leaves creators with limited options, none of which offer the level of control and customization they need to succeed. In contrast, Edge Commerce Stack ($197) provides a comprehensive solution that lets creators deploy a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

When it comes to restricted countries, most payment gateways simply block transactions, leaving creators without a way to sell their products. Edge Commerce Stack ($197), on the other hand, uses NOWPayments, a blockchain-based payment processor that allows creators to accept international crypto payments without relying on traditional payment gateways. This means that creators in Pakistan can now sell their digital products to buyers worldwide, regardless of their location.

Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership and automation are key aspects of any successful online business. With traditional payment gateways, creators often have to rely on third-party services to handle payment processing and product delivery. Edge Commerce Stack ($197) takes a different approach, providing creators with full ownership and control over their products and customer data. This means that creators can automate their entire business, from payment processing to product delivery, without relying on external services.
